hooks.command: bash -c 'pane_id="${WEZTERM_PANE:-unknown}"; if [ -n "$CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION" ]; then echo "resurrect: nested claude (child marker) - not claiming pane $pane_id" >&2; cat > /dev/null; elif [[ "$pane_id" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then cat > "$HOME/.claude/pane-sessions/${pane_id}.json"; else echo "resurrect: invalid WEZTERM_PANE: $pane_id" >&2; cat > /dev/null; fi'
